in_marathi.name: Sureshraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth and Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sureshraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sureshraj is a combination of two words - 'Suresh' meaning 'God' and 'Raj' meaning 'King' or 'Rule'. Thus, Sureshraj means 'God of Wealth and Victory'. It is a powerful name that denotes the one who rules over wealth and brings prosperity.
